[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] was served by a '''receptionist droid''' when she resumed the role of [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] following the resignation of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] during the [[Almanian Uprising]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] managed the access to Mothma by ordering guests. When the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] tried to see Mothma, this receptionist droid kept placing them at the bottom of the waiting list.
